name: blood-bank-monorepo
description: Tooling-only root for the Blood Bank Management System. Real apps live under server/, client/, and public-frontend/.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client

_lint-staged-note: Commands must receive ONLY the staged paths lint-staged appends. Do not point these at `npm run format`/`lint:fix` — those are `prettier --write .` / `eslint . --fix`, which reformat the whole server tree on every commit. eslint is omitted here because server/eslint.config.js ignores src/**/*.ts (tsc + vitest cover that tree) and eslint cannot resolve its config from the repo root.
